name: Forest banana salad
summary: Wild banana flowers, naturally sweet, are diced into a sweet-and-sour broth with chicken, pork or beef ears, herbs, and roasted peanuts.
taste: The wild banana flowers are sweet, and the broth is sweet and sour.
howToEat: Share it as a salad plate at lunch.
seoTitle: Forest banana salad in Mang Den
seoDescription: Diced wild banana flowers in a sweet-and-sour broth with chicken, pork or beef ears, herbs, and roasted peanuts.
